text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, look at that crowd!
New Year's in Japan really is lively.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness. Regarding our outing today, you do remember what you promised, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand.
'I will never stray from my guards'!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, you don't need to worry so much.
Trainer is with me, after all—ah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I forgot to say it!
Happy New Year♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! Let's make this
the best year yet!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In the final time left to me...
I have to spend it smiling as much as I canâª

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Meanin' not a single one's gonna be left.
They're all just gonna turn into those "memories" you love so much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Air Shakur confronted me about the "deadline"...
Her expression back then was rigid.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I haven't forgotten anything.
The end was already decided from the very beginning, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My duty in my homeland is absolute to me.
It is something I must fulfill, and something I want to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even though I should really still be carrying out that mission, here I am, running freely and visiting the shrine for the New Year!
It's enough... more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: These past three years of my life are a gift given to me by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. A dreamlike time... born from the goodwill
of everyone involved in my life."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It was truly wonderful, and so much fun!
A precious, beloved... and happy time."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful.
That I may return to my mission with such happy memories in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking back, it was that way from the very start. She genuinely wishes to devote herself to others from the bottom of her heart. She doesn't view it as a sacrifice at all...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why! I'm going to enjoy every bit of it to the fullest
so I won't have any regrets!♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were undoubtedly her true feelings.
However—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, no more difficult talk!
After all the trouble of convincing you, Captain, I want to see as many wonderful things as possible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Would you escort me for New Year's?
choice_data_list: Praying for Growth! The Shrine Pilgrimage Marathon Course

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have a feeling we're going to have a wonderful time!
Let's head out right away♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we arrived at an upscale traditional restaurant that was approved from the list submitted in advance to the captain of the guard, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Those chopsticks...
They're celebratory chopsticks, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's the concept of *shinjin-kyōshoku*—dining with the gods, right?
One side is for the gods, and the other side is for people.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The length also has a meaning; it's related to the figure-8, which is considered an auspicious sign in Japan.
Another thing I found interesting was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seems to know the etiquette of various countries by heart;
her wealth of knowledge ended up being quite educational for me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~, that was quite enjoyable♪
Thank you very much for being such a wonderful escort.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that sounds fun!
Let's head out right away♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we began our tour of the shrines we'd researched beforehand, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done!
Trainer, next—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, are you okay?
We did walk quite a lot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come on, stand up and catch your breath!
We still have two more spots to go. Let's do our best♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion turned out to be
surprisingly Spartan...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~, that was quite enjoyable♪
Thank you very much for being such a wonderful escort.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!? I want to try that!
Let's definitely go!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Please wait.
You mean standing under a waterfall?
Since that carries some risk, we must deliberate for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, it might be dangerous
to challenge it completely unprepared.
So—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Are you really okay with this?
Having you test it first... almost feels like making you a royal food taster.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I'm worried about you~!
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splaasssshhhh...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...? Your lips are completely blue!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waterfall meditation was so cold and harsh that
I decided to tell her I performed the purification ritual
in her place... instead.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~, that was quite enjoyable♪
Thank you very much for being such a wonderful escort.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then to wrap things up and say thanks for today...
I'll escort you to my recommended ramen shop!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, of course!
They opened their shop for the New Year, so I have to repay that hospitality—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's Fine Motion...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hyek... Ah, s-sorry,
I'm j-just a fan...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for speaking to me.
Thank you as always for your support!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Um, races like the Queen Elizabeth II Cup were incredible!
I'll never forget it...! Well then...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...You won't forget, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to
forget about me either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion cast her eyes down for a moment,
but it was fleeting... and with her usual
bright smile, she headed for the ramen shop.
